What is SYNAPSMOS

Instagram shows what you look like.
LinkedIn shows what you've achieved.
SYNAPSMOS shows how you think —
and helps you find minds that share or stretch your thinking.

How It Works
01 / 03
🧠

Build Your Mind Map

Answer five questions. Your ideas become a visual constellation of beliefs, curiosities, and questions. No résumé. No photos. Just your mind, mapped.

02 / 03
⚡

Get Provoked Daily

A daily question could gently challenge something in your map. Answer in a few lines. Your thinking evolves; your map grows.

03 / 03
🌌

Discover Your Matches

The idea: meet people whose thinking overlaps with yours in some places and differs in others. No follower counts. A deeper map could make for more thoughtful introductions.

Ideas we are exploring
F—01
Daily

The Provocation

A daily question shaped by your map, designed to challenge rather than confirm.
F—02
Ongoing

Mind Matches

Introductions to people whose thinking intersects yours in meaningful ways.
F—03
Always

Mind Map Timeline

A visual diary of how your ideas change over time.

The goal is to make humanity's collective intelligence as close to a single, unified consciousness as possible — not to homogenize thinking, but to make the diversity of thought visible, connected, and alive.
